recipes.title: Fresh Herb Omelette
steps: Finely chop the chives, parsley and dill.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper, then stir in the herbs.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook, gently pulling the edges toward the center, until almost set.
Fold the omelette in half and slide it onto a plate.

recipes.title: Zucchini Chicken Omelette
steps: Dice the onion and slice the zucchini into thin half-moons.
Shred the cooked chicken into bite-size pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and cook the onion and zucchini until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and warm it through.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and cook until set.
Fold, cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach Mushroom Omelette with Parmesan
steps: Melt the butter in a pan and cook the mushrooms until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and pour them over the vegetables.
Cook until almost set, sprinkle with parmesan, fold and serve.
